notes: The 1919 Hamilton County Court House block fills Main-Sycamore from the Parkway to S. Court (pasted correction); E. Court St. (outlines of sheets 138 and 140) ends at Main from the west and at Sycamore from the east, opposite the court house, so both are T's; 'S. Court' (60') runs along its south side. East Central Parkway ('(E.S. Canal)' south roadway): only its south block line (y~925-936) is drawn here, the north half is on sheet 147; crossing y=668 is inferred from the 145 ft width printed on sheet 138 (south line minus half width) and is approximate (+/-20 px). Main's water pipes curve east by ~100 px going north across the Parkway; the Main/Parkway x uses the block lines south of it. Pancoast Alley: printed 'PANCOAST' (hand-lettered, reads like 'PHNCUHST') between S. Court and 9th (x~1768, 13') and 'PANCOAST' between 9th and 8th (x~1864, 12'): jogs ~95 px at 9th, so two T's there; continues south of 8th on sheet 133. Watson Alley: printed 'Alley'/'Watson' S. Court-9th (x~2162, 16'), 'Alley Watson' from 9th to the mid-block alley (x~2414, ~10'), and 'Watson Alley' from the mid-block alley to 8th (x~2226, 12'; continues on sheet 133). Swift Alley (printed 'Swift Al.' 10' west of Watson, 'Swift' 12' east) jogs 28 px at Watson: two T's. '?' = the unnamed mid-block alley between 9th and 8th (printed only 'Alley'): ~12 ft from Watson (upper) to Sycamore (centre y~3558), widened to 35 ft on its south side between Pancoast and Watson (lower) (big '4' printed there is a block number), and only a ~6 ft passage between Main and Pancoast (centre y~3548, with a water pipe in it).
